values.note: Scott County Conservation's 2026 schedule for all its campgrounds: electric $25, electric/water $27, electric/water/sewer $30, reservable sites $40, non-electric/tent $20; $1 off for Scott County residents and for seniors 62+. note: Scott County Conservation campground in West Lake Park, about 5 miles west of Davenport: back-in pads along parallel lanes off the park's west entrance road, plus a smaller loop and tent sites, inland from the park's lakes. --Claude
summary: Status added: temporarily closed 2026-09-07 for reconstruction, reopening ~Memorial Day 2027. Fees $25-40 added from the county's 2026 schedule. Year-round season, water, showers and dump confirmed; 50-amp and sewer cleared (county page lists neither). Booking: county WebTrac engine for limited May-Sep sites, otherwise FCFS, 14-night limit.
flags: CLOSED: Park Terrace is closed from 2026-09-07 for a full rebuild (new roads, concrete pads) and expected back around Memorial Day 2027; status written temporarily_closed. After reopening the site layout, pad lengths, hookups and possibly rates may change - worth a re-read in summer 2027.
PHONE: stored 563-328-3286 is the county's Wapsi Education Center line; West Lake Park's own number on the county pages is 563-328-3281 (apply.py does not write phone).

SEPARATE FROM SUMMIT (3188), keep both: the two campgrounds are ~1.1 km apart on different park roads (Park Terrace off the west entrance near the residential streets at 41.5199,-90.6855; Summit on the north road at 41.5293,-90.6830), each with its own page, season and amenities.
FEES: the county schedule is park-system-wide and does not map tiers to campgrounds; $25 (electric) to $40 (reservable) written. If Park Terrace is rebuilt with sewer, the low may become $30.

CLEARED: electric 50 and sewer true rested on the old note; the county's Park Terrace page lists 'Electricity' and 'Water' only (no amperage, no sewer). The WebTrac site list that would show amps was refused by Cloudflare and not retried.
FIT: pads are long back-ins on paved lanes; the old note's 'big-rig friendly' unconfirmed by the county, but the imagery shows pads a 23-ft rig fits easily.
WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' STANDS: no water within ~300 m on imagery; the park's lakes lie to the north and east.
